verdict.rationale: Glama's directory says every server is "scanned, scored". A community user confirms a quality-score system (TDQS) with letter grades they could improve against. Glama also documents verified ownership via a claim token, and the directory is pitched for comparing servers. Usage counts and health/liveness checks are not evidenced, and one hands-on report says score re-tests stalled until undocumented billing was added, which affects score freshness. Missing for 10: usage counts, health/liveness checks, first-party documentation of the scoring methodology and badge display, reliable score re-testing.

support.subject: As a developer, I can compare servers using published quality signals — usage counts, health or liveness checks, scores, or verification badges
